annotations.title: Open a vote for the pass holders of an event (hosts and organizers only)

description: Opens a vote for the people who added the event pass. Needs the event, a question and the options, as many as you name; the only limit is technical. One vote per pass, changeable until the vote closes, secret: counts only, never who. kind rating opens a rating vote instead: each guest scores the options in whole numbers on scale stars5 (default), num5 or num10. bestEnd is high (default) or low, low with numbers only; read the best end back to the host in words before opening. winnerRule average (default) or total; requireAll and minimum, ratings to place (default the larger of 5 and a tenth of the ballots), are settings too. kind ranking: guests place the options best first; settings places 1 to 5 or all (default 3), requireAll, minimumBallots (default 0). Without confirm it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it opens the vote and puts the line on every event pass without an alert. quiet false sends an alert, only when the host asks; for a vote already open without one, call again with the event, the question and quiet false. An alert counts against the notice limits: six an hour per event and Google's alerts per pass per day. Always call once without confirm and read the preview to the person; set confirm true only on the call after they say yes.

bestEnd.description: Rating only. Default high; low (1 is best) only with num5 or num10, not stars.

confirm.description: Absent previews; true opens the vote.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

kind.description: Default pick: one choice per pass. rating: each guest scores the entries (the options). ranking: each guest places the entries in order, best first.

minimum.description: Rating only. Ratings an entry needs to place; default the larger of 5 and a tenth of the ballots.

minimumBallots.description: Ranking only. Default 0 (none): ballots needed to name a winner.

options.description: The options, one plain line each, as many as you name. At least two to open a vote.

places.description: Ranking only. Default 3: guests place their top 3; 1 to 5, or all for every entry in order.

question.description: One plain line. No links or markup. Optional only with quiet false for a vote already open.

quiet.description: Default true: no alert. False sends an alert; only when the host asks.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id opens once.

requireAll.description: Rating and ranking. Default false: guests rate the ones they saw, or place at least one; true: every entry, or every place.

scale.description: Rating only. Default stars5 (5 stars); num5 is 1 to 5, num10 is 1 to 10.

winnerRule.description: Rating only. Default average: highest average wins; total: highest total.
